kind: Remaining CLI native-final-text bounded read-only feasibility audit
newCandidateAcceptance: Neither Pi nor Kimi plain-native-final-text candidate was implemented or executed by this audit. Existing envelope/MCP evidence does not imply acceptance of the new facade.
sharedBoundary: Only explicit per-Run FinalReply mode registered before launch authorizes publication. Model text is body only; Host binds original authenticated Worker, exact current session/launch/final identity, frozen delivered sequence and idempotency. Existing stale/unknown/ACK fences remain. Diagnostics alone never authorize action.

pi.feasibility: Conditionally feasible, but session/current-launch final identity needs a small new guard and two-turn fake proof. No native-final-text acceptance yet.
pi.observedHistoricalBoundary: Existing actual-CLI fake stdout shows session header, intermediate assistant message_end(stopReason=toolUse), terminal assistant message_end(stopReason=stop,responseId), agent_end(willRetry=false), then agent_settled(aborted=false). Historical evidence used MCP/body facade, not this candidate.
sourceSupport: print-mode.js emits session header and JSON subscription events, awaits prompt, then disposes/flushed output
agent-session.js agent_end is not settlement: retry/compaction/follow-up handling can precede agent_settled
resource-loader.js noContextFiles returns empty context-file list
proposedTerminalProof: exit0, complete JSONL, exact session header and current isolated launch
unique final assistant message_end with stopReason=stop, stable responseId, nonempty bounded text, no toolCall content; all business tool calls settled
agent_end(willRetry=false) and final agent_settled(aborted=false), no later generation/unfinished tool/error
cross-check current appended session-tree branch: new user entry and matching final responseId, excluding historical final from resumed session
pi.identityGap: turn_start/turn_end events represent model/tool steps and do not carry a stable user-turn ID. A fresh launch slice plus fixed session header and new session-tree entry/parent chain must bind the requested turn; timestamps alone are insufficient.
pi.truncationBoundary: Reject stopReason=length/error/aborted, missing settlement, incomplete JSONL, pending tools and mismatched/duplicate final. exit0 or agent_end alone is insufficient. Raw provider finish-reason normalization was not exhaustively audited, so do not claim all provider truncation semantics covered.
pi.memoryStatus: Historical isolated controls supplied --no-extensions --no-skills --no-context-files --no-prompt-templates with explicit session persistence. Installed loader proves context-file suppression. This audit did not certify an exhaustive Pi automatic-memory feature audit or native memory-off attestation; new candidate must verify every-launch controls/isolated agent directory and reject unknown version behavior. Ordinary same-session history remains enabled.
pi.authentication: Not probed; no claim that current paid authentication is usable.
pi.minimalNextStep: Reuse ordinary print/json and explicit same --session file in two separate arms; no schema/MCP extension. Two fake-provider turns with one real filesystem tool each, native final text to real Worker only in opted-in arm. Test wrong session/tree branch, intermediate final-looking text, length/aborted/agent_end-with-retry, duplicate/missing settled, unknown write. Verify per-response usage and memory controls before paid admission.

kimi.feasibility: More directly reusable terminal boundary than Pi: existing envelope validator already correlates explicit turn/step/raw provider stop. Removing only JSON envelope parsing under a new explicit native-final-text mode is plausible; still requires new negative/free proof.
reliableEvidence: stream-json session.resume_hint.session_id matched exact --session across launches
own-session wire has agentId=main, expected turnId, step.begin uuid, content.part stepUuid, step.end messageId/finishReason/providerFinishReason/rawFinishReason, and turn.ended

current final step requires end_turn + completed + raw stop; exactly one final text part, no final-step tool calls; all prior tool calls have results; one completed turn.ended with no later model activity
kimi.installedSourceSupport: main.mjs around317055–317085 preserves provider finish metadata; around318250–318305 writes step.end with turnId,stepUuid,messageId and normalized/raw finish reasons.
kimi.identityGap: Existing private validator itself accepts wire+expectedTurnId and does not independently authenticate session. Existing runner checks session.resume_hint separately and slices wire by wall time. New candidate should bind exact isolated session/wire path and pre-launch byte offset plus session ID, not rely solely on time-window filtering.
kimi.truncationBoundary: Existing fake negatives reject length despite completed, absent provider reason, wrong step/turn, thinking-only, duplicate end, pending tools and missing opt-in. These tests protected a JSON FinalReply envelope. Plain-text mode must rerun them and ensure arbitrary stdout/intermediate text cannot publish; exact raw stop rule is proven only for the observed provider binding.

memoryStatus.policy: not-applicable, not a claimed disable flag
memoryStatus.existingIsolation: Dedicated KIMI_CODE_HOME/HOME, explicit empty --skills-dir, empty MCP config, no parent AGENTS/CLAUDE/MEMORY files; each-launch version/config guards; normal session history preserved
memoryStatus.limits: Installed version matches bounded source audit. Not a global guarantee about future versions or all third-party memory/tool features; fail on unaudited upgrades.

historicalEvidence.freeEnvelope: Existing two-turn actual CLI/fake-provider envelope test reported distinct continuous sessions, business Bash call, two real Worker publications and ACK completions; old report25 tests. This is not new plain-text validation.
historicalEvidence.lastPaidAttempt: P142 stopped on native invalid authorization grant before any completed round; one request intent, no usage record. Cost unknown, not zero. This audit did not recheck or repair authentication.

kimi.minimalNextStep: Reuse the existing two-turn local fake Chat Completions fixture, ordinary print/stream-json and same --session. Bind per-Run FinalReply before launch, copy only verified current final text without JSON decoding into existing Worker submitter, retain frozen seq/idempotency/unknown-result behavior. Add plain-text positive and stale/unknown/wrong-session/length/intermediate-text negatives. Keep fake network loopback and account files untouched; authentication remains a separate future admission check.

decision: Enough source/history to justify two small free prototypes, not enough to claim either new candidate passed or authorize new paid calls.
